## Describe the Bug

## Steps to Reproduce

2. Select mode / role (`1 Player` or `2 Players`, `SCARER` or `LAUGHER`)
3. Perform action...
4. Observe error or unexpected behavior

What you expected to happen.

- JavaFX Version: [e.g. 26.0.1]
- Launch Method: [e.g. `mvn javafx:run` / IntelliJ IDEA]
